items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: Yes, Miss, Miss, Le Breton, Le Breton, her name. But it's Le Breton in French.

ctx.x: I forgot what that book was. I know you showed it to us one day.
Yes, Miss, Miss, Le Breton, Le Breton, her name. But it's Le Breton in French. So she took 42, if not longer than that, to write that book.
Well, she taught at Newcomb, didn't she? Hmm? She taught at Newcomb College, didn't she?
